# Levli

> Levli is the private GLP-1 companion that brings your medication, symptoms and progress together, so you can understand your journey without it taking over your life. It is built for people taking — or preparing to take — GLP-1 medications such as Mounjaro, Wegovy, Ozempic, Zepbound, Saxenda and Rybelsus.

# What Levli is

Levli is a private GLP-1 tracking and progress companion. It brings doses, medication history, weight, symptoms, habits and progress into one calm place, and helps a person see how their medication, symptoms, weight and habits relate over time. Where medication-level estimates are shown, they are clearly described as illustrative estimates, not clinical measurements.

# What Levli is NOT

Levli is not a medical service, a pharmacy or a prescriber. It does not prescribe medication, recommend a personalised dose, diagnose conditions or tell users to change their treatment. It does not replace a doctor, pharmacist or any healthcare provider. It is also not a generic weight-loss app, a calorie counter or a basic medication reminder. Medication level estimates shown in the app are illustrative only and are not clinical measurements. Users should always consult a qualified healthcare provider with any questions about their medication, dose or health.

# Who Levli is for

People already prescribed — or preparing to take — a GLP-1 medication who want a dedicated tool to understand their journey rather than a generic health app. They are often managing the journey largely by themselves and want control without obsession and support without judgement.

Three audience mindsets Levli serves:

- Goal-driven: wants accurate data, visible progress and clear goals.
- Zen seeker: wants simplicity, reassurance and less mental noise.
- Pathfinder: is new or uncertain and wants clear explanations, trustworthy information and social proof.

# Product value pillars

1. See the complete picture: doses, medication history, weight, symptoms, habits and progress in one experience.
2. Understand patterns: relationships between logged medication, side effects, appetite, weight and progress over time. Medication-level estimates are clearly described as estimates, not clinical measurements.
3. Stay organised: injection reminders, medication records, injection-site rotation, symptom logging and an accessible history.
4. Recognise progress: trends and meaningful progress rather than overemphasising daily weight fluctuations.
5. Feel privately supported: calm, non-judgemental language. Levli recognises the stigma and information overload around GLP-1s without becoming a social network or making weight loss a competition.

# How Levli differs

Most competitors position around tracking shots, calculating doses or losing weight. Levli positions around understanding the whole journey. It is more human and reassuring than a clinical medication log, more focused than an all-purpose health or calorie app, more private and dependable than a forum, less obsessive and diet-led than traditional weight-loss products, and broader than a basic injection reminder — without trying to replace a clinician.

# SEO territory

Levli's central SEO territory is GLP-1 tracking and journey management. Levli content covers:

- GLP-1 tracker app and GLP-1 companion searches.
- Mounjaro, Wegovy, Ozempic and Zepbound tracker searches.
- Injection reminders and injection-site rotation.
- Side-effect and symptom tracking.
- Dose history and medication schedule explainers.
- Weight trends, progress tracking and plateaus.
- Medication-specific educational guides.
- Relevant calculators (protein, calorie, BMI, BMR, TDEE) where useful to GLP-1 users.
- Comparisons such as best GLP-1 apps and free versus paid GLP-1 trackers.

Content answers the practical questions people search before and during treatment, and leads naturally back to Levli as the tool that helps them record and understand their own journey.

# Brand tone

Calm, clear, supportive, discreet and evidence-conscious. Levli avoids exaggerated transformation claims, shame, fear, clinical coldness, "miracle drug" language, aggressive diet culture and unrealistic before-and-after messaging.

# Messaging

- Primary headline: Understand your GLP-1 journey.
- Brand promise: Understand your GLP-1 journey. Stay in control of your progress.
- Supporting phrases: Your GLP-1 journey, made clearer. / More clarity. Less mental noise. / See your progress beyond the scale. / Everything about your journey in one place. / Track privately. Progress confidently.

- [FAQ](https://levli.app/#faq): Whether Levli is a medical service, which GLP-1 medications are supported, injection-site rotation, weight trends and plateaus, privacy, and how Levli differs from a general health or weight-loss app.

- [Terms of Use](https://levli.app/terms): Terms of use, including the medical disclaimer that Levli is not a medical service and does not provide medical advice.

# Important disclaimer

Levli is not a medical service. Always consult your healthcare provider. Medication level estimates are illustrative only and are not clinical measurements.
